title: Putnami Transaction Unit of Work (descriptor)
description: The request-side descriptor a caller hands to a transaction runner: how a transactional unit of work should be run — its propagation relative to an enclosing transaction, its isolation level, and whether it is read-only. It carries no result and no connection.

readOnly.description: When true, the unit of work performs no writes and the runner may open a read-only transaction.

unitOfWorkName.description: Optional logical unit-of-work identifier: lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '/'; 1–64 chars.

propagation.description: How the unit of work composes with an enclosing transaction. Closed enum. 'nested' = join-outer, no savepoints (the frameworks' current behaviour).

isolation.description: Transaction isolation level, mapped one-to-one onto Postgres isolation levels. Closed enum.
